text:
tina: Quick thread - PR 5022 (sdk-examples + migration guide) is awaiting legal/security redaction review. Planning to merge tomorrow morning during docs release window.

rahul: Which examples are affected? I skimmed and saw a Postgres connection string and a trivial curl example.

jess: The Postgres example accidentally had a real DB host `prod-db.internal.redwood`. We should redact that and add a placeholder + note.

tina: Yes. Proposed edits: replace host with `db-host.example`, change `password=SuperSecret!` to `password=[REDACTED]`, and add a top-of-page disclaimer about redaction.

legal-signal: @jess @tina I'll review the wording now. Please include a link to the internal redaction policy.

jess: Added diff on branch `docs/sanitize-5022` and pushed. Small snippet:
```diff
- connection = "postgres://user:SuperSecret!@prod-db.internal.redwood:5432/app"
+ connection = "postgres://user:[REDACTED]@db-host.example:5432/app"
```

security-bot: Automated scan found an env var example referencing `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` with a path containing `/secrets/`. Recommend replacing path with `/path/to/credentials.json` and an explicit rotate creds note.

rahul: I'm ok to approve once legal signs off. Adding a short paragraph about rotating credentials after following samples.

legal-signal: Approved with edits. New top disclaimer: "Sensitive identifiers and hostnames have been redacted from this public doc. For full internal examples, request access from legal@redwood.com."

security-bot: Security manual review +1. Please ensure docs CI linkcheck is re-run.

docs-bot: Docs preview: https://ci.redwood.dev/preview/5022 sha=abc123. Lint warnings fixed. Linkcheck passed.

tina: Great, schedule for merge tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll coordinate with release notes.

jess: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up if anything else shows in staging. :thumbsup:
